target_customer: Developers building LLM applications that need knowledge retrieval
problem: Naive retrieval augmented generation is unreliable in production; Superpowered offered an API with proprietary retrieval techniques such as AutoQuery and Relevant Segment Extraction.

founders.name: Zach McCormick
prior_employers: A small quant hedge fund (Chief Investment Officer)
education: Applied Mathematics degree, institution not named

founders.name: Dillon Martin
prior_employers: Bank of America Merrill Lynch (financial advisor)

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval pipeline with chunking and ranking techniques was nontrivial but implementable by a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Retrieval techniques were reproducible and platform vendors and frameworks soon offered RAG.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: RAG became a standard feature in model and vector database platforms, per general market, not sourced to this company.

market_need_then: Not documented in sources dated 2022; the product launched amid early GPT-3.5 application building.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with another YC company (Superpowered, later Vapi) which caused source mixups.

outcome_analysis: Superpowered AI sold a RAG API and is listed Inactive by YC, with its site unreachable on fetch. No shutdown notice or cause is public. A different YC company, also called Superpowered, pivoted to Vapi, which causes frequent confusion; for this company the cause remains unknown and brand_confusion is only a weak inference.
notes: Website superpowered.ai could not be resolved on fetch. The 500K pre-seed rests on one database (VCBacked); date only approximate, one listing says May 2022. The TechCrunch Vapi story with a 2.1M seed concerns a different company (Jordan Dearsley, Nikhil Gupta), not recorded here. The YC launch post names no competitors. Cause of inactivity not public.
